title: Link text must describe the destination
text: Link text such as 'click here' gives no context out of order (WCAG 2.2 SC 2.4.4).

title: Promotional claims need backing
text: Factual or promotional claims (numbers, superlatives, comparisons) need an approved fact behind them.

title: Watch what the content implies, not just what it says
text: Indirect taunts, insinuation, sarcasm, double meanings, coded language and digs at others carry the brand's name as much as direct statements do, including across caption and image.

title: App outage, early October: blackout
text: During App outage, early October (2026-10-06 to 2026-10-09): Acknowledge the outage plainly; no jokes about downtime. Promotional and celebratory posts are paused while this runs; only service updates and messages about the event itself go out.

title: Festive Learning Fest: event brief
text: During Festive Learning Fest (2026-10-19 to 2026-10-29): Lead with what learners gain; the discount comes second. No countdown pressure.

title: KiteLearn 2.0 launch: event brief
text: During KiteLearn 2.0 launch (from 2026-11-11): Until launch day, tease the feeling, not the features: no screenshots, no dates.

title: No digs at other platforms
text: Talk about what we do. Never mock or compare against other learning platforms, by name or by hint.

title: Plain, warm words
text: Write like a good teacher: plain, warm and specific. No corporate jargon or hype.
